  2. Extra charges on bill .... 27 reviews  (Spreads across all platforms, especially Google, Zomato, Amazon and Swiggy; language is mainly English, Tamil and Tanglish.)
  3. Small portion size ....... 14 reviews  (Seen on Google, Zomato, Amazon and Swiggy; often tied to value-for-money complaints; English, Tamil and Tanglish.)

TOP PRAISE
  Tasty biryani (44 mentions), Neat, leak-proof packaging (24 mentions), Friendly staff (11 mentions)

URGENT: 26 reviews need a reply within 24 hours

ACTION ITEMS
  1. Remove or pre-disclose all packing and service charges on menus, order screens, and bills, and have staff explain them proactively at checkout.
  2. Tighten delivery handoff with the delivery partners on evening and Friday-night orders, including pickup-time checks and escalation for late or wrong orders before dispatch.
  3. Review portioning for the most complained-about dishes and set a minimum serving standard so the value feels fair at current price points.
